name: Genius.fun
description: A permissionless token launchpad on BNB Smart Chain with bonding-curve trading, multiple quote assets, creator fee distributions, and graduation into permanently locked PancakeSwap Infinity liquidity

methodology.Fees: Token creation, bonding-curve trading (including any launch-window surcharge), Genius hook trading and paid Alpha promotion fees. Fees accrue at launch/trade/promotion; settlements are excluded. Meme-denominated hook fees use the same swap’s quote/meme execution-price ratio, rounded down to quote base units.
methodology.Revenue: The Genius platform share of trading fees under each launch’s immutable policy, plus separately labeled creation and Alpha promotion fees. The creator-selected destination allocation (Foundation or creator), creator share and launched-meme buyback allocations are excluded.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The same protocol-retained portion as Revenue. Genius.fun has no protocol token receiving these fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator-selected destination allocations (Foundation or creator), creator shares and accrued funding for buybacks of individual launched meme tokens, calculated from immutable per-launch policies with contract integer rounding.

Fees.Curve Trading Fees: CurveBuy and CurveSell fee + tax; CurveBuy.fee already contains any snipe surcharge.
Fees.Hook Trading Fees: HookFeeCollected feeAmount + taxAmount, valued in the pool’s paired quote asset at the originating trade’s execution price when needed.
Fees.Token Creation Fees: One historical factory launchFee per TokenLaunched, replaying same-period fee changes in log order.
Fees.Alpha Promotion Fees: Actual BNB paid in AlphaPromoted events, including zero-cost grants.

Revenue.Curve Fees To Genius: The platform share of bonding-curve fees under each launch’s immutable fee policy.
Revenue.Hook Fees To Genius: The platform share of accrued Genius hook fees; meme-denominated fees are valued at the originating swap’s execution price.
Revenue.Token Creation Fees To Genius: Token creation fees retained by Genius, using the historical factory fee and intraperiod LaunchFeeUpdated events.
Revenue.Alpha Promotion Fees To Genius: Actual paidWei in AlphaPromoted events; free grants contribute zero.

ProtocolRevenue.Curve Fees To Genius: The platform share of bonding-curve fees under each launch’s immutable fee policy.
ProtocolRevenue.Hook Fees To Genius: The platform share of accrued Genius hook fees; meme-denominated fees are valued at the originating swap’s execution price.
ProtocolRevenue.Token Creation Fees To Genius: Token creation fees retained by Genius, using the historical factory fee and intraperiod LaunchFeeUpdated events.
ProtocolRevenue.Alpha Promotion Fees To Genius: Actual paidWei in AlphaPromoted events; free grants contribute zero.

SupplySideRevenue.Curve Fees To Foundation: Creator-selected destination allocation from curve fees routed to the shared Foundation vault; excluded from Genius platform revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Hook Fees To Foundation: Creator-selected destination allocation from hook fees routed to the shared Foundation vault; excluded from Genius platform revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Curve Fees To Creators: Creator share, any destination share selected for the creator, and separate creator tax on curve trades.
SupplySideRevenue.Curve Fees For Meme Buybacks: Accrued curve-fee allocation reserved to buy back and burn that launch’s meme token.
SupplySideRevenue.Hook Fees To Creators: Creator share, any destination share selected for the creator, and separate creator tax on hook trades.
SupplySideRevenue.Hook Fees For Meme Buybacks: Accrued hook-fee allocation reserved to buy back and burn that launch’s meme token.
